title: 11. Production: Failures, Scale & Security: LangChain RAG Patterns — RetrievalQA vs LCEL
summary: LangChain has two generations of RAG abstractions. RetrievalQA (legacy): a high-level chain that wraps retriever + LLM + prompt into a single object — easy to use but hard to customize, instrument, or extend.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: LangChain has two generations of RAG abstractions. **RetrievalQA** (legacy): a high-level chain that wraps retriever + LLM + prompt into a single object — easy to use but hard to customize, instrument, or extend. **LCEL (LangChain Expression Language)** (modern): a composable pipe-based syntax (`chain = retriever | prompt | llm | parser`) that is transparent, async-native, streamable, and trivially extensible. Every production RAG system should use LCEL: it enables streaming, parallel branches, conditional routing, and full observability via LangSmith without any extra code.

quiz.question: What is Haystack and how does it differ from LangChain?
options: MTEB (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark) evaluates embedding models across retrieval, classification, clustering, and semantic similarity tasks.
Ingestion: Docling/Unstructured → LangChain text splitters → OpenAI embeddings → Qdrant.
LangSmith is LangChain's observability platform. Every LCEL chain call is traced: inputs, outputs, latency, cost per step, errors.
Haystack (deepset, 2020) is production-focused, enterprise-grade: declarative YAML pipelines, built-in evaluation framework (deepeval), native Elasticsearch integration,…
quiz.explanation: Haystack (deepset, 2020) is production-focused, enterprise-grade: declarative YAML pipelines, built-in evaluation framework (deepeval), native Elasticsearch integration, strong typing. LangChain is more flexible and has more integrations but is more "glue code" and less structured.

quiz.question: Vector DB comparison — when do you choose each?
options: MTEB (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark) evaluates embedding models across retrieval, classification, clustering, and semantic similarity tasks.
OpenAI (text-embedding-3-large): best quality, $0.13/1M tokens, 3072-dim, Matryoshka (truncatable), low latency via API.
Use framework (LangChain/LlamaIndex): 80% of use cases, faster to production, battle-tested, community support.
Qdrant: open-source, best filtering performance (payload indices), Rust-based (fast), great for multi-tenant with payload filtering.
quiz.explanation: Qdrant: open-source, best filtering performance (payload indices), Rust-based (fast), great for multi-tenant with payload filtering. Best for: teams that need self-hosting, strong filtering, hybrid search. Pinecone: fully managed, no ops, good at scale, built-in metadata filtering.
